items.title: CISA Warns of SolarWinds Web Help Desk RCE Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
items.description: An urgent warning regarding a critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in SolarWinds Web Help Desk. items.title: Eclipse Foundation Mandates Pre-Publish Security Checks for Open VSX Extensions
items.description: The Eclipse Foundation, which maintains the Open VSX Registry, has announced plans to enforce security checks before Microsoft Visual Studio Code (VS Code) extensions are published to the open-source repository to combat supply chain threats. The move marks a shift from a reactive to a proactive approach to ensure that malicious extensions don't end up getting published on the Open VSX Registry.
